entities.name: Query Psd1-like protein
observations: Sequence query has strong homology to reviewed fungal mitochondrial phosphatidylserine decarboxylase proenzyme 1 homologs.
Likely catalyzes phosphatidylserine-to-phosphatidylethanolamine conversion and participates in phospholipid/PE biosynthesis; inference from homolog annotations.
Likely mitochondrial inner membrane associated, with catalytic portion on intermembrane-space side; inferred from homolog annotations.

entities.name: O14333
observations: Reviewed Schizosaccharomyces pombe phosphatidylserine decarboxylase proenzyme 1; homology to query: 50.4% identity, 80.7% query coverage, E-value 1.02e-128.
Annotated to catalyze phosphatidylserine decarboxylation to phosphatidylethanolamine and localized to mitochondrial inner membrane, intermembrane side.
